title: Creamy Adzuki Bean Soup
description: A comforting and nutrient-rich soup made with adzuki beans, perfect for a chilly evening. The addition of milk gives it a creamy texture.
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the adzuki beans to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the soup simmer for 30-40 minutes, or until the adzuki beans are tender.
Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
